name: Sugar+Spice 2
source:
Hibiki moves in with his older sister after his father went abroad for business. However, his cousin Fuuka also lived there and he worried about being able to get along with her since they are unfamiliar with each other. However, they get along nicely. One day, Fuuka asks him to come shopping with her and a friend since they need help carrying bags. He agrees, but when he arrives, he meets a senpai who he admires, Ginga. She asks him why he’s here and what he wants to do. Realizing that he doesn’t have a goal or a dream to pursue, Hibiki decides to begin living with a new purpose.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
父亲出国工作后，响搬去和姐姐同住。然而，表妹风花也住在那里。由于两人此前并不熟悉，他担心自己无法和她相处，结果两人却意外合得来。一天，风花邀请他陪自己和朋友一起购物，因为她们需要有人帮忙提袋子。他答应下来，到场后却遇见了自己仰慕的前辈银河。银河问他为什么会来这里，又想做些什么。意识到自己没有追求的目标或梦想后，响决定开始带着新的目标生活。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
